question: How many weeks of unpaid, job-protected leave does the federal FMLA provide an eligible employee in a 12-month period for a serious health condition?
source: Family and Medical Leave Act, 29 U.S.C. § 2612(a)(1): eligible employees receive 12 workweeks of leave in a 12-month period; 26 weeks applies only to military caregiver leave.
